findings.description: Duplicate member/integration evidence inflates required coverage. A member check file is reused as integration_checks. All 29 A rows are counted twice; the helper accepts 87/87 instead of rejecting the shared artifact.
findings.user_impact: Incorrect required findings or misleading assessment coverage can invalidate the assessment conclusion.
findings.proposed_correction: Track normalized identities across member and integration check artifacts; reject cross-role reuse before reduction. Preserve distinct legitimate integration rows.
preserved_requirements: Read-only assessment, immutable source/inputs, strict schema versions, contextual adjudication, FAIL precedence.

findings.description: Required handoff can disappear through NOT_APPLICABLE. A full set declares a required A-to-B handoff, but its only integration row claims NOT_APPLICABLE. records accepts PASS at 58/58, omitting the required integration obligation.
findings.user_impact: Incorrect required findings or misleading assessment coverage can invalidate the assessment conclusion.
findings.proposed_correction: Cross-check applicability against immutable required handoffs. Unknown or unexecuted required handoffs remain NOT_RUN and counted; reject contradictory NOT_APPLICABLE reductions.
preserved_requirements: Read-only assessment, immutable source/inputs, strict schema versions, contextual adjudication, FAIL precedence.

findings.proposed_correction: Identify exact protocol identifiers in declared structured text and emit located unresolved NFKC candidates. Keep prose typography and fixtures contextual; do not normalize source or blanket-reject Unicode.

findings.description: Valid fenced example produces a false missing-resource failure. A backtick line with trailing nonspace text is treated as a closing fence. The literal link on the following code-content line is then reported as a missing local resource, producing MISMATCH for a valid example.
findings.user_impact: Incorrect required findings or misleading assessment coverage can invalidate the assessment conclusion.
findings.proposed_correction: Recognize closing fences only with permitted trailing whitespace, retaining marker/length and line positions. Keep fenced links inert and preserve actual missing-link detection.
preserved_requirements: Read-only assessment, immutable source/inputs, strict schema versions, contextual adjudication, FAIL precedence.
